The ATO curve displays extensive endothermic transitions, signifying its crystalline characteristics
the NLC curve maintains relative stability with slight peaks, implying a semi-crystalline or amorphous lipid structure
The SPION thermogram exhibits negligible thermal transitions
the absence of atorvastatin’s distinct melting peaks signifies effective encapsulation within the lipid carrier
Pure ATO showed a distinct peak at approximately 3666.5 cm−1
the ATO-NLC F2 spectrum demonstrated that the characteristic ATO peaks were absent in comparison to the pure ATO spectrum
the SPION spectrum reveals that surface hydroxyl groups (Fe–OH) and the adsorbed water are responsible for the weak band at 1620 cm−1
The absence of the ATO and core composition peaks in the ASN spectrum confirmed NLC-SPION fabrication with efficient loading of ATO.
